full_name: Susan M. Reverby | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Susan M. Reverby, professor of women’s studies at Wellesley College, focuses her scholarship on issues of women’s agency, race, class, and gender in health care history and the ethics of research.
